title: Can an app improve your health? With Gary Bennett, PhD

sentences.en: Sponsored by Newport HealthCare, providing results-driven mental health care for teens and young adults ages 12 to 28 who are struggling with trauma, depression, anxiety,
sentences.zh: 本期节目由 Newport HealthCare 赞助，为 12 至 28 岁正与创伤、抑郁、焦虑及其他情绪、人格和共病障碍作斗争的青少年提供注重成效的精神健康护理。

sentences.en: and other mood, personality, and co-occurring disorders.
sentences.zh: 以及其他情绪、人格和共病障碍。

sentences.en: At Newport HealthCare, tailored treatment plans foster sustainable healing to help young people move from struggling to thriving.
sentences.zh: 在 Newport HealthCare，量身定制的治疗方案能够促进持久康复，帮助年轻人从苦苦挣扎走向蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: Learn more at newporthealthcare.com.
sentences.zh: Learn more at newporthealthcare.com.

sentences.en: The last few years have seen an explosion of digital technologies that promise to help people achieve their health and fitness goals.
sentences.zh: 过去几年里，数字技术呈爆发式增长，它们承诺帮助人们实现健康和健身目标。

sentences.en: There are apps to track your diet and weight, count your steps, and customize your exercise routine.
sentences.zh: 市面上有各种应用程序，可以追踪你的饮食和体重、计算步数，还能定制锻炼计划。

sentences.en: One 2022 market research report found that the global health and fitness app market is now worth $1.3 billion and predicted it would be worth more than $4 billion by 2030.
sentences.zh: 2022 年的一份市场研究报告发现，全球健康与健身应用市场的价值已达 13 亿美元，并预测到 2030 年将超过 40 亿美元。

sentences.en: These apps may be a commercial success, but are they a useful public health tool?
sentences.zh: 这些应用程序或许取得了商业上的成功，但它们是实用的公共卫生工具吗？

sentences.en: As the world confronts what public health organizations have called an obesity epidemic, what role might digital interventions play in combating it?
sentences.zh: 正当世界面临公共卫生组织所称的肥胖流行病时，数字干预措施能在与之对抗中发挥什么作用？

sentences.en: Do these apps work?
sentences.zh: 这些应用程序管用吗？

sentences.en: Do they help people adopt healthier habits?
sentences.zh: 它们能帮人养成更健康的习惯吗？

sentences.en: Or, conversely, might they contribute to the mental health toll that weight stigma can take in a culture that's obsessed with thinness?
sentences.zh: 或者相反，在一个痴迷于苗条的文化中，它们是否会加重体重污名化所带来的心理健康负担？

sentences.en: If you want to try using health and fitness apps, how can you find ones that are effective, helpful, and backed by research?
sentences.zh: 如果你想尝试使用健康和健身应用程序，怎样才能找到那些有效、有用且有研究支持的应用呢？

sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, the flagship podcast of the American Psychological Association that examines the links between psychological science and everyday life.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学话你知》（Speaking of Psychology），这是美国心理学会的旗舰播客，主要探讨心理科学与日常生活之间的联系。

sentences.en: I'm Kim Mills.
sentences.zh: 我是金·米尔斯（Kim Mills）。

sentences.en: Our guest today is Dr. Gary Bennett.
sentences.zh: 我们今天的嘉宾是加里·贝内特（Gary Bennett）博士。

sentences.en: Dr. Bennett is a clinical health psychologist and professor of psychology and neuroscience, global health, and medicine at Duke University,
sentences.zh: 贝内特博士是一位临床健康心理学家，也是杜克大学心理学与神经科学、全球健康和医学教授。

sentences.en: where he is also vice provost for undergraduate education.
sentences.zh: 他同时担任杜克大学负责本科生教育的副教务长。

sentences.en: He is the founding director of the Duke Global Digital Health Science Center, where his research focuses on designing, testing,
sentences.zh: 他是杜克全球数字健康科学中心的创始主任，该中心的研究重点是设计、测试和推广针对肥胖及其他慢性健康状况的数字疗法，尤其是面向医疗弱势患者。

sentences.en: and disseminating digital treatments for obesity and other chronic health conditions, particularly for medically vulnerable patients.
sentences.zh: 贝内特博士是行为医学会的前任主席，已发表了 150 多篇科学论文。

sentences.en: Dr. Bennett is a past president of the Society of Behavioral Medicine, and has authored more than 150 scientific papers.
sentences.zh: 他的研究成果已被《纽约时报》、美国国家公共电台、《时代周刊》等许多媒体报道。

sentences.en: His research has been featured in the New York Times, NPR, Time, and many other media outlets.
sentences.zh: 他还创立了三家数字健康初创公司，并为数字健康和消费电子组织提供健康行为改变科学方面的咨询。

sentences.en: He has also founded three digital health startups and advises digital health and consumer electronic organizations on the science of health behavior change.
sentences.zh: 欢迎贝内特博士今天做客我们的节目。

sentences.en: Thank you for joining us today, Dr. Bennett.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: My pleasure is mine.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for the invitation.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您的邀请。

sentences.en: Let's start with a definition, as we often do on this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 让我们从一个定义开始，正如我们在这个播客中经常做的那样。

sentences.en: Many of us are familiar with some commercial health and fitness apps.
sentences.zh: 我们许多人都熟悉一些商业健康和健身应用程序。

sentences.en: You know, we've probably seen ads for Noom or downloaded things like MyFitnessPal.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们可能看过 Noom 的广告，或者下载过 MyFitnessPal 之类的东西。

sentences.en: Is that what you're looking at when you study digital health interventions?
sentences.zh: 这正是你研究数字健康干预时所关注的内容吗？

sentences.en: How broad is the category, and what do you consider a real digital health intervention?
sentences.zh: 这个范畴有多广，你认为真正的数字健康干预是什么样的？

sentences.en: Indeed, and we've all been inundated with advertisements of all types for these digital apps.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，我们所有人都被这些数字应用程序的各种广告狂轰滥炸过。

sentences.en: And that is what we study.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们所研究的。

sentences.en: So we're very interested in the effectiveness of the digital apps that, again, so many of us are using to manage our weight and improve our physical activity,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们对这些数字应用程序的有效性非常感兴趣，再次强调，我们当中有那么多人在使用它们来管理体重、改善体育活动，以及改善睡眠。

sentences.en: to help with our sleep.
sentences.zh: 以及改善我们的睡眠。

sentences.en: And we are trying to create these in a laboratory setting in a way that we hope will make them maximally effective.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图在实验室环境中以一种我们希望使其效果最大化的方式来创建这些应用程序。

sentences.en: And the apps that we create in the scientific community look and feel and behave a little bit differently than what you see in the commercial realm.
sentences.zh: 我们在科学界创建的应用程序，其外观、感觉和行为与你在商业领域看到的略有不同。

sentences.en: And I hope we can get to a conversation about that.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们能就此展开对话。

sentences.en: They're a little bit different.
sentences.zh: 它们确实有点不同。

sentences.en: But fundamentally, we're just trying to help people improve their health in an easy, accessible way using the tools that they tend to use all day, every day, anyway.
sentences.zh: 但从根本上说，我们只是试图利用人们无论如何都会一整天、天天都在使用的工具，以一种简单、易用的方式帮助人们改善健康。

sentences.en: So much of your research is focused on digital interventions for obesity.
sentences.zh: 你的很多研究都集中在针对肥胖的数字干预上。

sentences.en: How well do these work and what makes them effective?
sentences.zh: 这些方法效果如何？是什么让它们发挥作用？

sentences.en: There are two answers to that question.
sentences.zh: 这个问题有两个答案。

sentences.en: So let's, for a moment, just focus on what we know about the kinds of apps that so many people are downloading onto their phones.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们先花点时间关注一下我们所了解的那类应用程序，即有这么多人正在下载到手机上的应用。

sentences.en: These are the apps that you can go to the app store of various types and download and use today, the ones that are in the commercial space.
sentences.zh: 这些就是你可以去各种应用商店下载并立即使用的应用程序，也就是商业领域的那些应用。

sentences.en: The short answer is we know very little about whether and how they work, how well they work.
sentences.zh: 简短的回答是，我们对它们是否起作用、如何起作用以及效果如何知之甚少。

sentences.en: We especially know very little about how well they work relative to one another and how well they work relative to established treatments that we know work very well.
sentences.zh: 我们尤其知之甚少的是，它们彼此相比效果如何，以及与我们明知非常有效的既定疗法相比效果如何。

sentences.en: So if you were to go to your doctor and go to a weight loss group, perhaps in your local community that's based on strong weight loss science,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你去看医生，或者去当地社区参加可能基于强大减肥科学的减肥小组，

sentences.en: we have a good sense of how well they work, particularly over the long time horizon that is necessary for people to have durable and kind of persistent weight losses.
sentences.zh: 我们对它们的效果有很好的了解，特别是对于人们获得持久且持续的体重减轻所必需的长周期而言。

sentences.en: We don't really know how well apps work relative to those kinds of treatments.
sentences.zh: 我们其实并不知道应用程序与这类疗法相比效果如何。

sentences.en: And in fact, much of what we've learned thus far suggests that they work minimally and not as well as we might like,
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们迄今为止学到的很多东西都表明，它们的效果微乎其微，没有我们希望的那么好，

sentences.en: and certainly not as well as do those very established treatments.
sentences.zh: 而且肯定不如那些非常成熟的疗法那么有效。

sentences.en: So then there's the second answer to that question is how well do the apps work that we're testing in the research world?
sentences.zh: 那么第二个答案是：我们在研究领域测试的应用程序效果如何？

sentences.en: So for me and my colleagues who do digital health science, we're creating apps all the time and broad digital treatments that incorporate lots of different components.
sentences.zh: 所以对于我和从事数字健康科学的同事来说，我们一直在创建应用程序和包含许多不同组件的广泛数字疗法。

sentences.en: They look and feel quite a lot like what you could download in the app store, but generally speaking, you can't download them in the app store.
sentences.zh: 它们的外观和感觉与你可以在应用商店下载的东西非常相似，但总体而言，你无法在应用商店中下载它们。

sentences.en: These are things that we're testing in the lab.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我们在实验室里测试的东西。

sentences.en: Those treatments, they work pretty well.
sentences.zh: 这些疗法效果相当不错。

sentences.en: So generally speaking, we see that people can lose somewhere between, call it seven, eight pounds of weight at about six months, which for us is a pretty good outcome.
sentences.zh: 因此，总的来说，我们看到人们在大约六个月内可以减轻大约 7 到 8 磅的体重，对我们来说，这是一个相当不错的成果。

sentences.en: That's really the ceiling though.
sentences.zh: 不过这实际上就是上限了。

sentences.en: There's a lot of that that is like, that's about the most amount of weight you're going to lose with one of these digital apps.
sentences.zh: 这其中有很多情况就像是，这大约是你用这些数字应用程序能减掉的最大体重了。

sentences.en: There's a lot of variability in how much weight people lose.
sentences.zh: 人们减掉的体重存在很大的变异性。

sentences.en: And so one of the things that's really important in this conversation is that those of us who do the science of obesity treatment think very differently about weight loss than do many folks in the public.
sentences.zh: 因此，这次对话中非常重要的一点是，我们这些从事肥胖治疗科学研究的人，对减肥的看法与公众中的许多人有很大不同。

sentences.en: We're fundamentally interested in producing weight losses that will help people improve their health generally,
sentences.zh: 我们从根本上有兴趣产生能够帮助人们全面改善健康的减重效果，

sentences.en: and then more specifically help to improve things like blood pressure, glucose, lipids, like your cholesterol, those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 然后更具体地帮助改善血压、血糖、血脂（如胆固醇）等指标。

sentences.en: And frankly, you don't need to lose a whole lot of weight to see major improvements in those kinds of outcomes, in your blood pressure, in your glucose, in your cholesterol,
sentences.zh: 坦率地说，你不需要减掉太多体重就能看到这些结果发生重大改善，比如你的血压、血糖、胆固醇，

sentences.en: your triglycerides.
sentences.zh: 以及你的甘油三酯。

sentences.en: We're not generally as interested in the large amount of weight loss that so many people want in order to kind of go to the beach in the summer or get ready for a wedding or those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 我们通常对许多人为了夏天去海滩、准备婚礼或类似事情而追求的大量减重兴趣不大。

sentences.en: What we know, generally speaking, is that most apps that you can download today don't deliver those kinds of weight losses.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我们所知道的是，今天你能下载的大多数应用程序都无法带来那种程度的体重减轻。

sentences.en: So what makes an app work for people?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么让一款应用程序对人们起作用呢？

sentences.en: Why do the ones that you're using in the lab work more effectively than something that I might just arbitrarily go buy in the app store?
sentences.zh: 为什么你在实验室里使用的那些应用比我随便在应用商店里买的东西更有效？

sentences.en: Well, one of the reasons is that we're basing the apps in the scientific community on literally a generation or two of research about what contributes to successful weight loss.
sentences.zh: 嗯，原因之一是，我们在科学界开发的应用程序是基于整整一两代关于什么有助于成功减肥的研究。

sentences.en: And generally speaking, what makes an app work in the scientific world are the kinds of components that you should be looking for in the apps that you download commercially.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，让一款应用程序在科学界发挥作用的各种组件，也正是你在购买商业应用时应该寻找的组件。

sentences.en: And so those components would be things like self-monitoring or tracking.
sentences.zh: 这些组件包括自我监测或追踪。

sentences.en: Secondly, if an app isn't asking you to track what you're eating or what you're drinking or really something, something you can stick with.
sentences.zh: 其次，如果一款应用程序不要求你追踪你吃的东西、喝的东西，或者确实是某种你能坚持下去的东西。

sentences.en: We've done a lot of work in tracking one's weight.
sentences.zh: 我们在追踪体重方面做了大量工作。

sentences.en: Then it's not going to work.
sentences.zh: 那么它就不会起作用。

sentences.en: One of the things we know the most about is that you have to track something.
sentences.zh: 我们最了解的事情之一就是你必须追踪某些东西。

sentences.en: And we can talk a bit more if you're interested about why this works, but you have to track something.
sentences.zh: 如果你感兴趣，我们可以多聊聊为什么这很有效，但你必须追踪某些东西。

sentences.en: Second thing is the app has to teach you skills.
sentences.zh: 第二件事是应用程序必须教你技能。

sentences.en: It has to teach you how to manage your calorie consumption, your food consumption, what you're drinking, your physical activity,
sentences.zh: 它必须教你如何管理卡路里摄入、食物摄入、你的饮食、你的体育活动，

sentences.en: particularly during times when you're stressed or when you're around other people.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在你感到压力或是身处社交场合的时候。

sentences.en: It has to teach you how to engage with your food in a way that helps you to be able to maximize your weight loss.
sentences.zh: 它必须教你如何以一种有助于你最大程度减轻体重的方式来对待食物。

sentences.en: And there's a whole realm of skills that we know work.
sentences.zh: 我们知道有一整套技能是有效的。

sentences.en: And the app has to teach you that.
sentences.zh: 而应用程序必须教会你这些。

sentences.en: The third thing that we know really works well is support.
sentences.zh: 我们知道确实非常有效的第三件事是支持。

sentences.en: And this is one of the most counterintuitive things about the digital space.
sentences.zh: 这是数字领域最违反直觉的事情之一。

sentences.en: Almost all apps that work very well for weight loss include some type of support.
sentences.zh: 几乎所有对减肥非常有效的应用程序都包含某种类型的支持。

sentences.en: And that support is often delivered by a human counselor.
sentences.zh: 这种支持通常由人类顾问提供。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's via chat.
sentences.zh: 有时是通过聊天。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's via phone.
sentences.zh: 有时是通过电话。

sentences.en: Sometimes it's in person.
sentences.zh: 有时是面对面。

sentences.en: But apps that don't include support of some type generally have much smaller outcomes than apps do that include support.
sentences.zh: 但是不包含某种支持的应用程序，其效果通常比包含支持的应用程序要小得多。

sentences.en: And you have to modify something.
sentences.zh: 而且你必须改变某些东西。

sentences.en: You have to eat less, move more.
sentences.zh: 你必须少吃多动。

sentences.en: We can have lots of debates about the specific diets that apps recommend.
sentences.zh: 我们可以对应用程序推荐的具体饮食进行大量辩论。

sentences.en: And generally speaking, I'm not a fan of any particular diet.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我不赞成任何特定的饮食法。

sentences.en: Science pretty strongly suggests you should just do something you can stick with.
sentences.zh: 科学强烈表明，你应该只做你能坚持下去的事情。

sentences.en: But if you download an app that says you don't have to track something, you don't have to change what you're eating and drinking, then you're not going to see weight losses.
sentences.zh: 但如果你下载了一款声称你不需要追踪任何东西、不需要改变饮食和饮水习惯的应用程序，那么你是不会看到体重减轻的。

sentences.en: OK, it's actually not more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，其实没有比这更复杂的了。

sentences.en: So in the scientific community, our apps do all of those things.
sentences.zh: 所以在科学界，我们的应用程序会做所有这些事情。

sentences.en: And when you're looking for an app that you can download from your app store, you want to also be looking for those things.
sentences.zh: 当你寻找可以从应用商店下载的应用程序时，你也应该寻找这些功能。

sentences.en: So an app that sends electronic messages of encouragement or reminders, right?
sentences.zh: 那么，一个发送鼓励电子信息或提醒的应用程序，对吧？

sentences.en: That's not the same as human intervention.
sentences.zh: 这与人工干预是不一样的。

sentences.en: Does that matter?
sentences.zh: 这重要吗？

sentences.en: And my other question is, are people more motivated if they are actually paying for an app?
sentences.zh: 我的另一个问题是，如果人们真的为应用程序付费，他们的动力会更足吗？

sentences.en: So on the first point, yes.
sentences.zh: 关于第一点，是的。

sentences.en: Getting reminders, getting a little bit of support, a little reinforcement, a little pat on the back, those are tremendous.
sentences.zh: 获得提醒、获得一点支持、一点强化、一点鼓励，这些都太棒了。

sentences.en: And you absolutely should be looking for that in your app.
sentences.zh: 你绝对应该在你的应用程序中寻找这些。

sentences.en: That's a little different than the kind of support I'm talking about, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，这与我所说的那种支持略有不同。

sentences.en: So the support that really works well is support that's of the type that helps you to problem solve.
sentences.zh: 真正发挥良好作用的支持是那种能够帮助你解决问题的支持。

sentences.en: When you're having a difficult time, when you're going out with colleagues or with friends and you're trying to figure out how you're going to approach eating that evening,
sentences.zh: 当你度过一段艰难时期，当你和同事或朋友外出，试图弄清楚当晚该如何对待饮食时，

sentences.en: having someone to talk to and talk through that.
sentences.zh: 身边有人可以交谈并一起探讨。

sentences.en: When you've had a slip or slide, you've consumed more than you wanted to on the weekend, like the big plate of nachos I had last weekend.
sentences.zh: 当你出现失误或退步，在周末摄入了超出预期的食物时，比如我上周末吃的那盘大份玉米片。

sentences.en: You know, you want somebody to try to talk to, to help manage that, those kinds of situations,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你需要找人倾诉，以帮助应对这种情况，

sentences.en: that kind of support is really the kind of gold standard support that leads to the largest weight losses.
sentences.zh: 这种支持才是真正能带来最大减重效果的黄金标准支持。

sentences.en: And, you know, the second question you asked him about if you're paying for an app, will you stick with it longer?
sentences.zh: 你问的第二个问题是，如果你为应用程序付费，你会坚持更长时间吗？

sentences.en: The answer is yes.
sentences.zh: 答案是会的。

sentences.en: And that gets to a really fundamental challenge for those of us who are designing these kinds of apps.
sentences.zh: 这就触及了我们这些设计此类应用程序的人所面临的一个非常根本的挑战。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, what really matters for long-term weight loss is not what you're doing today or tomorrow in the app.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，对长期减肥真正重要的不是你今天或明天在应用程序里做什么。

sentences.en: It's what you're doing six months, seven months down the road with the app.
sentences.zh: 而是你六个月、七个月后还在用这个应用做什么。

sentences.en: Weight loss is a long-term game.
sentences.zh: 减肥是一场持久战。

sentences.en: And we're often thinking about, as psychologists, is how do we motivate you to stay involved,
sentences.zh: 作为心理学家，我们经常思考的是，如何激励你保持参与，

sentences.en: to stay engaged with these kinds of digital treatments for the long-time horizon that it takes to be able to lose weight and keep it off.
sentences.zh: 为了减肥并保持体重所需的漫长周期，让你持续使用这些数字疗法。

sentences.en: And so, anything that we can do to keep you engaged is really critical.
sentences.zh: 因此，任何能让我们保持你参与度的事情都至关重要。

sentences.en: And paying for apps seems to be helpful in keeping you engaged.
sentences.zh: 而为应用程序付费似乎有助于保持你的参与度。

sentences.en: So, it's not, you know, it works by through that engagement function that's just so important.
sentences.zh: 所以，它之所以起作用，是通过那个极其重要的参与功能来实现的。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, what we find in all the studies that have looked at this question is whether you're paying for the app or you're not paying for the app,
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我们在所有研究过这个问题的人的研究中发现，无论你是否为应用程序付费，

sentences.en: whether you're using a science-based app or one that comes off the app store, is that people have declining engagement.
sentences.zh: 无论你使用的是科学应用还是应用商店下载的应用，人们的参与度都在下降。

sentences.en: Over time, it just gets harder and harder to stick with these apps.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，坚持使用这些应用程序变得越来越难。

sentences.en: And that's the really important scientific question that so many of us are struggling with right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们许多人目前正在纠结的真正重要的科学问题。

sentences.en: What about the apps that make you put in a goal, a weight loss goal?
sentences.zh: 那些让你输入目标、设定减肥目标的应用程序呢？

sentences.en: And so, maybe you weigh 150 pounds and you put in that you want to weigh 110.
sentences.zh: 比如，也许你体重 150 磅，你输入说你想瘦到 110 磅。

sentences.en: You know, is that crazy?
sentences.zh: 你知道，这不是很疯狂吗？

sentences.en: Does that help people or is that more discouraging than anything else?
sentences.zh: 这能帮到人们，还是说比什么都更让人灰心？

sentences.en: It's critically important to have a weight loss goal.
sentences.zh: 拥有一个减肥目标至关重要。

sentences.en: So, that's the first answer.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是第一个答案。

sentences.en: Second part of that is though, it's critically important to have an achievable weight loss goal, right?
sentences.zh: 但第二部分是，拥有一个可实现的减肥目标至关重要，对吧？

sentences.en: So, you know, sometimes with some of these apps that don't give you feedback about your weight loss goal, I get a little bit concerned.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，有时对于某些不针对你的减肥目标给出反馈的应用程序，我有点担心。

sentences.en: You know, you're 150 pounds and you put in 100 pounds, you're going to lose 100 pounds in three months.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你体重 150 磅，却输入 100 磅，想要在三个月内减掉 50 磅。

sentences.en: That's not possible or, you know, it's possible.
sentences.zh: 这是不可能的，或者说，这可能吗？

sentences.en: We're smart.
sentences.zh: 我们很聪明。

sentences.en: Certainly not smart.
sentences.zh: 这绝对不明智。

sentences.en: You don't want to do that, I can promise.
sentences.zh: 我向你保证，你不会想这么做的。

sentences.en: We generally think that a safe amount of weight loss is somewhere between 5% to 10% of your body weight today.
sentences.zh: 我们通常认为，安全的减重数量是你当前体重的 5% 到 10% 之间。

sentences.en: And generally, the other way to think about this is it's safe to lose about a pound or two a week.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，另一种思考方式是，每周减重大约一到两磅是安全的。

sentences.en: If you lose much more rapidly than that, you can put yourself in an unsafe situation, but you can also put yourself in an unsustainable situation.
sentences.zh: 如果你减得比这快得多，你不仅会让自己处于不安全的情况，还会让自己陷入不可持续的境地。

sentences.en: People who lose massive amounts of weight rapidly have a tendency to gain it back.
sentences.zh: 迅速减掉大量体重的人往往会反弹。

sentences.en: So, it's a kind of slow and steady amount of weight loss is what we're going after.
sentences.zh: 所以我们追求的是一种缓慢而稳健的减肥速度。

sentences.en: And yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: If you use an app that doesn't allow you to put a weight loss goal or doesn't give you a weight loss goal, you should look for one that has that feature.
sentences.zh: 如果你使用的应用程序不允许你设定减肥目标或不给你设定减肥目标，你应该寻找具备该功能的应用程序。

sentences.en: So, weight and obesity are complicated topics.
sentences.zh: 因此，体重和肥胖是复杂的话题。

sentences.en: I mean, they're a health issue, but there's a lot more than health wrapped up in how people think about weight.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，体重本身是个健康问题，但在人们对体重的看法中，掺杂了远超健康的各种因素。

sentences.en: And in recent years, there's been a lot of discussion about the toll that weight stigma can take in a culture that's obsessed with thinness as ours is.
sentences.zh: 近年来，在一个像我们这样迷恋骨感的文化中，人们对体重污名化可能造成的伤害进行了大量讨论。

sentences.en: Are you concerned that some of these weight loss apps are actually adding to the problem by contributing to a focus on weight that could be harmful to people's mental and physical health?
sentences.zh: 您是否担心其中一些减肥应用程序实际上加剧了这个问题，因为它们过度关注体重，可能会损害人们的心理和生理健康？

sentences.en: Yeah, I am.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的确担心。

sentences.en: I'll say I'm more concerned about the societal challenge of weight stigma.
sentences.zh: 但我必须说，我更担心的是体重污名化带来的社会挑战。

sentences.en: And it's a pervasive public health challenge.
sentences.zh: 这是一个普遍存在的公共卫生挑战。

sentences.en: And I really do think it is a public health challenge for us, especially given the high rates of obesity that we have in this country.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为这对我们来说是一个公共卫生挑战，尤其是考虑到我们国家目前的高肥胖率。

sentences.en: The fact that weight stigma is so normalized and so frequently experienced by people is a major concern.
sentences.zh: 体重污名化如此普遍，人们又如此频繁地经历这种污名化，这是一个亟待解决的重大问题。

sentences.en: And, you know, I have a student right now in my lab, Christina Hopkins, who's doing some really important groundbreaking work, I think, on this question.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我实验室里现在有一名学生，叫克里斯蒂娜·霍普金斯（Christina Hopkins），我认为她在这一课题上正在做一些非常重要且具有开创性的工作。

sentences.en: And what she finds is that experiencing weight stigma makes it harder for sure to lose weight.
sentences.zh: 她的研究发现，遭受体重污名化无疑会使减肥变得更加困难。

sentences.en: There's no question about that.
sentences.zh: 这一点毫无疑问。

sentences.en: But it exacts a significant emotional toll.
sentences.zh: 但它会带来沉重的心理代价。

sentences.en: It can affect your cardiovascular system.
sentences.zh: 它会影响你的心血管系统。

sentences.en: It can raise your blood pressure in the same way that we know other types of discriminatory stress can affect the body.
sentences.zh: 它会升高你的血压，就像我们知道其他类型的歧视性压力会影响身体一样。

sentences.en: It's a major challenge.
sentences.zh: 这是一个巨大的挑战。

sentences.en: And so I am concerned that the ease of accessing treatments via app can, for some people, lead to some challenging outcomes.
sentences.zh: 因此，我确实担心，通过应用程序轻松获得治疗，对某些人来说可能会导致一些棘手的结果。

sentences.en: But again, I think the societal challenge of weight stigma is really the bigger problem.
sentences.zh: 但话又说回来，我认为体重污名化带来的社会挑战才是真正更大的问题。

sentences.en: And it's the thing that we need to contend with.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们需要应对的问题。

sentences.en: When I talk about obesity and when most of us in the business talk about obesity, we really think of this as a health condition, as a root cause of so many chronic illnesses,
sentences.zh: 当我谈论肥胖时，以及我们行业里大多数人谈论肥胖时，我们真的把它看作是一种健康状况，是许多慢性病的根本原因，

sentences.en: cardiovascular disease, diabetes, cancer.
sentences.zh: 比如心血管疾病、糖尿病、癌症。

sentences.en: It is a risk factor that if we can address, we can really do a lot to improve people's health.
sentences.zh: 这是一个风险因素，如果我们能加以解决，就能在很大程度上改善人们的健康。

sentences.en: And in Cree, for the last five years,
sentences.zh: 在过去五年里，在Cree（克里族/机构名），

sentences.en: I would say all of us are struggling with how to talk about obesity and weight loss in a way that maximizes our attention to the health challenges associated with it and minimizes the kind of stigma that we might be placing on our patients.
sentences.zh: 我想我们所有人都在纠结，该如何谈论肥胖和减肥，既能最大限度地关注与之相关的健康挑战，又把对患者可能造成的污名化降到最低。

sentences.en: So you've been studying digital interventions for other chronic health conditions in addition to obesity, and you just mentioned a few of them.
sentences.zh: 所以除了肥胖，你一直在研究针对其他慢性健康状况的数字干预措施，你刚刚提到了其中几个。

sentences.en: What other health conditions can apps effectively address?
sentences.zh: 应用程序还能有效解决哪些其他健康状况？

sentences.en: And are these things that people can do on their own?
sentences.zh: 这些是人们可以自己做的事情吗？

sentences.en: Like, how do you track your own cholesterol, for example?
sentences.zh: 比如，你如何追踪自己的胆固醇？

sentences.en: Yeah, there's good evidence that we can help people to manage their blood pressure using apps.
sentences.zh: 是的，有充分的证据表明，我们可以通过应用程序帮助人们控制血压。

sentences.en: You know, particularly for folks who have hypertension,
sentences.zh: 你知道，特别是对于患有高血压的人，

sentences.en: there was a change made in the definitions of hypertension and the guidelines for hypertension treatment a couple of years ago.
sentences.zh: 几年前，高血压的定义和高血压治疗指南发生了一些变化。

sentences.en: And overnight, I mean, literally millions of Americans, you know, developed hypertension diagnosis because the hypertension guidelines were reset a little bit lower.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，我是说字面意思上的数百万美国人，你知道的，都被诊断出了高血压，因为高血压的诊断标准稍微调低了一些。

sentences.en: And the first line treatment for a new hypertension diagnosis at a very low level is changing your diet and your physical activity.
sentences.zh: 而对于新诊断出的轻度高血压，首选治疗方法就是改变饮食和增加体育锻炼。

sentences.en: These are things that we know work.
sentences.zh: 这些都是我们知道有效的方法。

sentences.en: So a lot of the existing weight loss apps that help you to change your diet and physical activity can also be useful for these chronic conditions and particularly hypertension and diabetes.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多现有的帮助你改变饮食和锻炼的减肥应用程序，对于这些慢性病，特别是高血压和糖尿病，也可以发挥作用。

sentences.en: We know that one of the best strategies to prevent the transition from what we used to call pre-diabetes, very, very low levels of diabetes,
sentences.zh: 我们知道，要阻止病情从我们以前所说的糖尿病前期（非常非常轻度的糖尿病），

sentences.en: to full-blown type 2 diabetes is actually changing your diet, your physical activity, and losing about 7% of your body weight.
sentences.zh: 恶化为完全确诊的2型糖尿病，最好的策略之一其实是改变饮食、增加锻炼，并减轻大约7%的体重。

sentences.en: So there's a way in which just focusing on changing your diet, improving your physical activity can have a range of benefits.
sentences.zh: 因此，仅仅专注于改变饮食和改善体育锻炼，就能带来一系列的好处。

sentences.en: There are definitely bespoke apps for managing your cholesterol and managing your blood pressure, managing your A1C.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些专门用于管理胆固醇、控制血压和控制糖化血红蛋白（A1C）的定制应用程序。

sentences.en: But for the most part, I'd say a lot of the weight loss actually do a really good job of modifying,
sentences.zh: 但在大多数情况下，我认为很多减肥应用在修改方面其实做得很好，

sentences.en: helping us to modify the risk factors for those conditions and helping a lot of patients to self-manage their conditions.
sentences.zh: 它们帮助我们改变这些病症的风险因素，并帮助许多患者实现病情的自我管理。

sentences.en: So you just mentioned self-management, but how do digital interventions fit into the larger healthcare picture?
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到了自我管理，那么数字干预在更大的医疗保健体系中处于什么位置？

sentences.en: Are they something that people should be using in consultation with their physician or use on their own or a little of both?
sentences.zh: 人们是应该在咨询医生的情况下使用它们，还是自己单独使用，亦或是两者兼有？

sentences.en: My answer to this question has shifted a lot over the last couple of years, particularly for obesity treatment.
sentences.zh: 在过去几年里，我对这个问题的看法发生了很大变化，尤其是对于肥胖症的治疗。

sentences.en: For a long time, we suggested that patients talk to their doctor about their obesity,
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间以来，我们都建议患者与医生谈论他们的肥胖问题，

sentences.en: but the evidence was pretty clear that a lot of patients with obesity weren't receiving treatment for their obesity or counseling about their weight in the primary care setting.
sentences.zh: 但证据非常明确，许多肥胖患者在基层医疗机构中并没有接受肥胖治疗或体重咨询。

sentences.en: And there's good reasons for that.
sentences.zh: 这背后有充分的原因。

sentences.en: It's a very time-intensive and expertise-intensive kind of undertaking that most physicians weren't trained to do or don't feel comfortable doing, weren't reimbursed to do,
sentences.zh: 这是一项非常耗时、极其专业的工作，大多数医生没有接受过这方面的培训，或者觉得做起来不自在，也没有获得相应的报酬，

sentences.en: didn't have the time to do.
sentences.zh: 而且没有时间去做。

sentences.en: And so for a long time, I thought, I mean, a lot, in fact,
sentences.zh: 所以在很长一段时间里，我以为——事实上，很多，

sentences.en: one of the reasons I started doing a lot of this work was to help to provide an additional treatment strategy that might help physicians to offload the obesity treatment to the app.
sentences.zh: 我开始做大量这方面工作的原因之一，就是为了提供一种额外的治疗策略，帮助医生将肥胖治疗的工作转移给应用程序。

sentences.en: So it's something that they didn't have to do in the course of their treatment.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就不用在治疗过程中亲自去做了。

sentences.en: But in the last couple of years, what we've realized, including some studies that have come out of our group,
sentences.zh: 但在过去的几年里，我们意识到，包括我们团队开展的一些研究在内，

sentences.en: it shows pretty clearly that when your physician knows about the treatment, the app that you're using to manage your weight,
sentences.zh: 都非常清楚地表明，当你的医生了解你正在使用的、用来控制体重的应用程序时，

sentences.en: and when that physician gives you reinforcement, guidance, validation, pat on the back for using those apps, you actually lose more weight.
sentences.zh: 当这位医生对你使用这些应用程序给予肯定、指导、认可和鼓励时，你实际上会减掉更多体重。

sentences.en: And it's a pretty straightforward story.
sentences.zh: 这个道理其实很简单。

sentences.en: A lot of us feel very accountable to our physicians.
sentences.zh: 我们中的很多人对医生都有一种责任感。

sentences.en: A lot of us check in with our physicians to make sure we're doing the right thing.
sentences.zh: 我们中的很多人都会向医生咨询，以确保我们的做法是正确的。

sentences.en: And when that physician feels like the app is the right thing for you to use and it's giving you good guidance and good validation, we tend to do a little bit better.
sentences.zh: 当医生认为某个应用程序适合你使用，并能给你提供良好的指导和肯定时，我们往往会做得更好。

sentences.en: We tend to be a bit more motivated and a little bit more adherent and engaged with those apps.
sentences.zh: 我们往往会更有动力，更有依从性，也更能积极使用这些应用程序。

sentences.en: So my strong suggestion these days is that if you're trying to lose weight using an app, let your physician know.
sentences.zh: 所以我现在强烈建议，如果你正在尝试用应用程序减肥，请让你的医生知道。

sentences.en: Let them know what app you're using.
sentences.zh: 让他们知道你在用什么应用程序。

sentences.en: Let them know how you're using the app and get them involved in that process.
sentences.zh: 让他们知道你是如何使用这个应用程序的，并让他们参与到这个过程中来。

sentences.en: And I suspect it may have some benefits.
sentences.zh: 我猜这可能会带来一些好处。

sentences.en: It certainly can't hurt.
sentences.zh: 至少百利而无一害。

sentences.en: Sponsored by Newport Healthcare.
sentences.zh: 本节目由纽波特医疗保健（Newport Healthcare）赞助播出。

sentences.en: Dedicated to providing sustainable healing for young people struggling with mental health concerns so they can move from self-destruction to self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 致力于为受心理健康问题困扰的年轻人提供可持续的康复治疗，帮助他们从自我毁灭走向自尊自信。

sentences.en: Based in compassion and driven by outcomes,
sentences.zh: 以同情心为基础，以治疗效果为导向，

sentences.en: Newport serves teens and young adults ages 12 to 28 at residential and outpatient programs nationwide.
sentences.zh: 纽波特在全国范围内通过住宿和门诊项目为12至28岁的青少年和年轻人提供服务。

sentences.en: Through tailored treatment and family support,
sentences.zh: 通过量身定制的治疗和家庭支持，

sentences.en: Newport successfully addresses psychological and behavioral health issues, including depression, anxiety, PTSD, personality disorders, and substance abuse.
sentences.zh: 纽波特成功解决了心理和行为健康问题，包括抑郁症、焦虑症、创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）、人格障碍和物质滥用。

sentences.en: Learn more at NewportHealthcare.com.
sentences.zh: Learn more at NewportHealthcare.com.

sentences.en: For some of our listeners who maybe want to try some of these apps, how do they find the ones that are effective?
sentences.zh: 对于我们当中可能想尝试这些应用程序的听众来说，他们该如何找到那些有效的应用呢？

sentences.en: Or maybe they even want to use the apps that you're developing.
sentences.zh: 或者他们甚至想使用你正在开发的应用程序？

sentences.en: Are there studies that you're doing right now that people could enroll in?
sentences.zh: 你们目前有没有正在进行、人们可以参加的研究？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 有的。

sentences.en: So I'd say, you know, in the commercial space, the thing to do is, you know, get money of the apps that are widely available right now don't have a strong evidentiary basis.
sentences.zh: 所以我想说，你知道，在商业领域，方法是，你知道，很多广泛提供的应用程序并没有坚实的证据基础。

sentences.en: Meaning there's not a lot of research trials that show that they work.
sentences.zh: 这意味着没有大量研究试验来证明它们有效。

sentences.en: So again, I think you want to look for those things in self-monitoring, the support, the skills training, those kinds of those issues.
sentences.zh: 所以再说一次，我认为你要寻找的是自我监测、支持、技能培训这几个方面的功能。

sentences.en: And download an app that you can stick with.
sentences.zh: 并下载一个你能坚持使用的应用程序。

sentences.en: So one of the most important things in all of obesity treatment, whether you're talking about the specific diet that you're adopting or the app that you're using,
sentences.zh: 因此，在所有的肥胖治疗中，无论你讨论的是你采用的具体饮食还是你使用的应用程序，最重要的事情之一就是，

sentences.en: it's all about being consistently engaged over an extended period of time.
sentences.zh: 关键在于要在较长的一段时间内保持持续使用。

sentences.en: There are just some apps I like, I just like the way they look better, right?
sentences.zh: 有些应用程序就是很讨人喜欢，我就是喜欢它们的界面外观，对吧？

sentences.en: Like I like the colors.
sentences.zh: 就像我喜欢那些颜色一样。

sentences.en: I like the little things that pop up.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那些弹出来的小玩意。

sentences.en: They are easier to use.
sentences.zh: 它们用起来更方便。

sentences.en: Get the app that you can stick with for a long-term time, for the long time horizon.
sentences.zh: 选择一个你能长期坚持下去的应用程序。

sentences.en: Ideally, you would pick an app that has a little bit of evidence behind it.
sentences.zh: 理想情况下，你应该选择一款背后有一点证据支持的应用程序。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of companies in this space are getting better
sentences.zh: 我认为这一领域的许多公司在这方面做得越来越好，

sentences.en: about sharing that evidence as it becomes available.
sentences.zh: 它们在证据出炉时更愿意分享这些证据。

sentences.en: And I would make sure that you're picking apps that have a strong evidence basis.
sentences.zh: 我会确保你选择的是有强有力证据基础的应用程序。

sentences.en: We are absolutely doing trials all the time.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在进行试验。

sentences.en: And maybe we can put our website in the notes.
sentences.zh: 也许我们可以把我们的网址放在节目简介里。

sentences.en: And anybody out there who's interested in our work is welcome to contact us and get involved.
sentences.zh: 任何对我们的工作感兴趣的人都欢迎联系我们并参与进来。

sentences.en: Okay, we will definitely do that.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们一定会这么做的。

sentences.en: So people who are using these apps have to give up a fair amount of personal information.
sentences.zh: 因此，使用这些应用程序的人必须透露相当多的个人信息。

sentences.en: And privacy is a concern in tech right now, as well it should be.
sentences.zh: 隐私目前在科技界是一个令人担忧的问题，理应如此。

sentences.en: What can people do if they want to try these apps, but they're worried about giving up too much sensitive information?
sentences.zh: 如果人们想尝试这些应用程序，又担心泄露太多敏感信息，该怎么办？

sentences.en: Yeah, this is just a pernicious challenge.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个极其顽固的挑战。

sentences.en: We just haven't been able to nail this over the 20-ish years I've been doing this work.
sentences.zh: 在我从事这项工作的这二十年里，我们一直没能彻底解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And it's gotten increasingly more challenging at the patient level or user level to help navigate
sentences.zh: 而且在患者或用户层面，要应对所有这些繁杂的服务条款、

sentences.en: all the various terms of service and terms and conditions and privacy challenges here.
sentences.zh: 使用条件和隐私挑战，变得越来越困难了。

sentences.en: I'd say my general rule of thumb on this is that it's totally reasonable to download an app and use and invent a persona in order to evaluate whether or not that app works for you.
sentences.zh: 我想我对此的一般经验法则是，下载一个应用程序，然后虚构一个身份来评估这个应用程序是否适合你，这完全是合理的。

sentences.en: This is what I do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所做的。

sentences.en: Every time there's a brand new app that comes on the scene, I download it, I use it, and I have no shortage of variations on my name that allow me to try to hide a little bit.
sentences.zh: 每当市面上出现全新的应用程序时，我就会下载它，使用它，而且我有各种各样的名字变体，可以让我稍微隐藏一下自己。

sentences.en: There's only so much you can do in that space.
sentences.zh: 在这个领域，你能做的事其实也就这么多了。

sentences.en: I think, as I noted before, the apps that work the best are those that have support involved.
sentences.zh: 我想，正如我之前所说，效果最好的应用程序是那些包含支持服务的应用。

sentences.en: And so, there are some very strong apps that have great user communities where someone can get a lot of support from talking to other users or talking to coaches and counselors
sentences.zh: 因此，有一些非常棒的应用程序拥有极佳的用户社区，用户可以通过与其他用户交流，或者与应用程序中配备的教练和顾问交流，获得大量的支持。

sentences.en: that may be engaged in that app.
sentences.zh: 这些人员可能会参与到该应用中。

sentences.en: And I often recommend that people use fake names and things when you're using that as well.
sentences.zh: 我经常建议人们在使用这些应用时也使用假名之类的东西。

sentences.en: Getting involved actually does lead to better outcomes.
sentences.zh: 参与其中确实能带来更好的效果。

sentences.en: It's an important thing to do, but I rarely do that using my real name.
sentences.zh: 这是一件很重要的事情，但我很少用真名去做。

sentences.en: The area where I think this gets trickiest is in device integration.
sentences.zh: 我认为最棘手的地方在于设备的整合。

sentences.en: And we're starting to see a whole range of devices come on the scene that purport to help you with your weight loss, but also can be linked with so many of these apps.
sentences.zh: 我们开始看到市面上涌现出一系列宣称能帮减肥、但同时又能与众多此类应用程序联动的设备。

sentences.en: Obviously, we've had physical activity monitoring devices for a long time, but now they're monitoring
sentences.zh: 显然，我们很早就有了身体活动监测设备，但现在它们还在监测

sentences.en: GPS, right?
sentences.zh: GPS，对吧？

sentences.en: We have weight monitoring scales that are doing a whole lot more than just monitoring your weight sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我们还有体重监测秤，有时候它们做的远不止监测体重那么简单。

sentences.en: And of course, we're seeing continuous glucose monitors that some folks are using and connecting with their weight loss apps as well.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们还看到有些人正在使用持续血糖监测仪，并将其与减肥应用程序连接起来。

sentences.en: So, that's really where I think things get a little trickier.
sentences.zh: 所以，这正是我认为事情变得有些棘手的地方。

sentences.en: And my rule of thumb there with respect to device integration is to be judicious about if you're concerned about privacy, and not everyone is, but if you're concerned about
sentences.zh: 关于设备整合，我的经验法则是，如果你关心隐私（并不是每个人都在乎，但如果你关心隐私），

sentences.en: privacy, be judicious about whether you really need full integration of your devices with those apps.
sentences.zh: 就要审慎对待，看你是否真的需要将设备与这些应用程序进行全面整合。

sentences.en: I find that often you get a little feedback from the device itself, and that's good enough for me.
sentences.zh: 我发现通常你从设备本身就能获得一些反馈，这就足够好了。

sentences.en: And so, I often don't connect the devices with the apps just to ensure that at least there's some firewalling of my data into different silos.
sentences.zh: 所以我通常不会把设备和应用程序连接起来，只是为了确保我的数据至少能在不同的孤岛中进行某种防火隔离。

sentences.en: But again, I recognize not everybody's concerned about those things.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，我知道并不是每个人都关心这些问题。

sentences.en: And at this point, unfortunately, the challenge that we're doing a lot of confederation here to try to help you manage some of those privacy implications.
sentences.zh: 而不幸的是，在这一点上，我们目前正在做大量的整合工作，以试图帮你应对其中带来的一些隐私影响。

sentences.en: Your research center is called the Global Digital Health Science Center.
sentences.zh: 你的研究中心名为全球数字健康科学中心（Global Digital Health Science Center）。

sentences.en: Let's talk about the global part of that.
sentences.zh: 我们来谈谈其中的“全球”部分。

sentences.en: What role do you see digital interventions playing in healthcare outside the US, and how much work are you doing in other countries?
sentences.zh: 在你看来，数字干预在美国以外的医疗保健中扮演什么角色？你在其他国家开展了多少工作？

sentences.en: Yeah, so it's actually the same answer I would give to the utility of digital to help us reach disadvantaged communities in this country, which we think about digital as one of the
sentences.zh: 是的，其实这和对于数字技术帮助我们接触国内弱势群体的实用性的回答是一样的，我们认为数字技术是

sentences.en: best strategies.
sentences.zh: 最佳策略之一。

sentences.en: In the early days, I used to say it was one of the best strategies.
sentences.zh: 早期的时候，我曾说它是最佳策略之一。

sentences.en: Now, I think it is the very best strategy to help us reach populations that have difficulty accessing high-quality healthcare.
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为它是帮助我们接触那些难以获得高质量医疗服务的群体的终极策略。

sentences.en: I think there's very little question about that right now.
sentences.zh: 目前对此几乎没有什么好质疑的。

sentences.en: In the early days, a lot of us were very concerned about the digital divide, but now, both in
sentences.zh: 早期，我们许多人都非常担心数字鸿沟，但现在，无论是在

sentences.en: the US and in populations around the world, many low-income populations, folks that are
sentences.zh: 美国还是世界各地的群体中，许多低收入群体、医学上脆弱的群体、地理位置偏远的群体，

sentences.en: medically vulnerable, geographically distant, they are connected through their mobile devices in a very significant way.
sentences.zh: 他们都通过移动设备实现了紧密的连接。

sentences.en: In some ways, sometimes in some places, including in the US, they're more connected than our more advantaged populations via their mobile devices.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，在某些地方（包括美国），他们通过移动设备获得的连接甚至比我们那些更有优势的群体还要紧密。

sentences.en: And so it just allows us a really tremendous opportunity to reach people we haven't been able to easily reach before and to deliver high-quality care through these digital means.
sentences.zh: 因此，这为我们提供了一个巨大的契机，让我们能够接触到以往难以轻易触及的人群，并通过这些数字手段提供高质量的护理。

sentences.en: We've done work in China and collaboratively in Africa.
sentences.zh: 我们在中国以及在非洲开展了合作研究。

sentences.en: And so we're very interested in how these tools might help us to traverse these.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们对这些工具如何帮助我们跨越这些鸿沟非常感兴趣。

sentences.en: There's often a real and perceived distance between high-quality care and patients in more disadvantaged communities.
sentences.zh: 高质量护理与生活在更弱势社区的患者之间，往往存在着实际以及人们感知上的距离。

sentences.en: And the good news, I think, at least in our early experience, is that a lot of our tools work a little better in these global circumstances than they do in the US.
sentences.zh: 好消息是，至少根据我们早期的经验，我们的许多工具在全球这些特定环境下的效果，比在美国本土还要好一些。

sentences.en: They work a little better in lower-income populations than they do in higher-income populations in many cases.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，它们在低收入群体中的效果比在高收入群体中还要好一些。

sentences.en: I know that feels confounding in some respects, but the evidence, I think, is pretty promising in that regard.
sentences.zh: 我知道这在某些方面让人感到有些费解，但我认为相关的证据在这方面相当令人鼓舞。

sentences.en: So I see massive potential for growth globally over the next 10 years, for sure.
sentences.zh: 因此，毫无疑问，我看到了未来十年全球增长的巨大潜力。

sentences.en: Is that just because Americans don't like to be told what to do?
sentences.zh: 这只是因为美国人不喜欢被别人指手画脚吗？

sentences.en: What's the reason for that?
sentences.zh: 原因是什么？

sentences.en: Do you know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: No comment on that one.
sentences.zh: 无可奉告。

sentences.en: But I will say that one of the things, one of the phenomena that you see a lot in these when you're studying digital health devices is that people tend to churn their apps very,
sentences.zh: 但我还是要说，在研究数字健康设备时，你会经常看到这样一种现象：人们更换应用程序的频率非常非常

sentences.en: very frequently.
sentences.zh: 高。

sentences.en: So they'll play with an app for a little while, and they'll download the next one, they'll download the next one, they'll download the next one, they'll download the next one.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会玩一会儿这个应用，然后下载下一个，再下载下一个，再下载下一个，再下载下一个。

sentences.en: And we don't see that quite as commonly when we're doing global work.
sentences.zh: 我们在做全球性项目时，往往不常见到这种情况。

sentences.en: People tend to stick with the app.
sentences.zh: 人们往往会继续使用这款应用。

sentences.en: So we're not loyal.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的忠诚度不高。

sentences.en: We're a little bit less loyal.
sentences.zh: 我们的忠诚度要稍微低一些。

sentences.en: I mean, this is one of the reasons why, for a long, long time, if I'm on an airplane and somebody asks what I do, and I say I'm a professor, they say, what do you profess?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是为什么很长一段时间以来，如果我在飞机上，有人问我做什么工作，我说我是个教授，他们就会问，你教授什么？

sentences.en: And then I say, we laugh.
sentences.zh: 然后我说完，我们都笑了。

sentences.en: And then I say, I do digital health research.
sentences.zh: 然后我说，我从事数字健康研究。

sentences.en: It's quite counterintuitive.
sentences.zh: 这相当反直觉。

sentences.en: Almost nothing, almost none of these digital approaches work among young people and among young adults.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么，几乎没有一种数字方法在年轻人和年轻成年人中奏效。

sentences.en: There is very, very little evidence that we can produce health changes using apps in folks who are 20 to 40.
sentences.zh: 有非常非常少的证据表明，我们可以在20到40岁的人群中使用应用程序来改善健康状况。

sentences.en: Give me somebody who is north of 50, 55 any day in any of my trials, and they're going to do a lot better.
sentences.zh: 在我的任何试验中，随便给我一个50岁、55岁以上的人，他们都会表现得好得多。

sentences.en: And a lot of it has to do with this.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上与此有关。

sentences.en: And when you're a digital native, you're just used to churning, right?
sentences.zh: 当你是一个数字原住民时，你习惯了不断更换应用，对吧？

sentences.en: You try something for a little while, and then you throw it away and try the next thing.
sentences.zh: 你尝试了一会儿，然后抛弃它，再去尝试下一个。

sentences.en: And as I mentioned before, so much of the promise of digital health depends on people being engaged with the app, actually using the thing.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前提到的，数字健康的许多前景都有赖于人们对应用的参与度，也就是真正使用它。

sentences.en: And what we find for folks who are a little bit older is they try it, they like it, they stick with it.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，对于年纪稍大的人来说，他们尝试了，喜欢了，就会坚持下去。

sentences.en: Now, this isn't something that you research directly, but I'm curious to hear your thoughts on mental health apps, since that's an area that's also received a lot of attention.
sentences.zh: 现在，这不是那种你可以直接研究的东西，但我很想听听你对心理健康应用的看法，因为这也是一个备受关注的领域。

sentences.en: Do you see a role for digital mental health interventions in addressing what some people are calling a mental health crisis?
sentences.zh: 你认为数字心理健康干预措施在应对人们所说的心理健康危机方面能发挥作用吗？

sentences.en: It is indeed a crisis, particularly among our young people.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一场危机，尤其是在我们的年轻人当中。

sentences.en: It's a pandemic on the order of others that we've experienced.
sentences.zh: 这是一场与我们经历过的其他疫情同等规模的大流行。

sentences.en: It is the thing that literally in my administrative role at Duke would keep me and my colleagues up at night prior to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 在疫情之前，我在杜克大学担任行政职务时，这绝对是让我和同事们夜不能寐的事情。

sentences.en: And the thing that I'm most concerned about as we come out of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在走出疫情时最关心的事。

sentences.en: Um, the Surgeon General has spoken very eloquently about this in recent years.
sentences.zh: 嗯，卫生外科总监近年来对此进行了非常精彩的阐述。

sentences.en: And the truth is that we don't have, we don't have great solutions right now.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们目前并没有、也没有极佳的解决方案。

sentences.en: The mental health challenges, again, particularly facing young folks.
sentences.zh: 心理健康的挑战，再次强调，特别是在年轻人中。

sentences.en: Um, but as is evidenced by the, by the recent loss of Naomi Judge really extends, extends, uh, you know, throughout, throughout our population at all ages.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如最近失去娜奥米·贾奇所证明的那样，它确实延伸到了、延伸到了，你知道的，我们所有年龄段的人口当中。

sentences.en: Um, it's just something we have, we have a massive challenge with.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这只是我们面临的一个巨大挑战。

sentences.en: We have, we are, um, we're unbelievably under optimized in the number of mental health care providers in this country relative to the size of the challenge.
sentences.zh: 我们面临的，我们是，嗯，与挑战的规模相比，我们这个国家的心理健康服务提供者的数量严重不足。

sentences.en: And so for that reason, I am quite bullish on the potential of apps to help us meet the
sentences.zh: 因此，出于这个原因，我非常看好应用程序的潜力，它们能够帮助我们满足

sentences.en: need of the broad swath of the American population who are dealing with, uh, lower levels of anxiety,
sentences.zh: 广大美国民众的需求，这些人正在应对，嗯，较低水平的焦虑、

sentences.en: depression, burnout, stress, feelings of sadness for those kinds of, of, you know, what you could, you, we might call subclinical or, um, just the kind of overarching feelings
sentences.zh: 抑郁、精疲力竭、压力、悲伤情绪，对于那些，你知道的，你可以称之为亚临床的，或者，嗯，只是那种全面性的

sentences.en: of sadness and burnout, stress, those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 悲伤和倦怠感、压力以及诸如此类的情绪。

sentences.en: I think app based approaches can be very, very useful as a first line offering, um,
sentences.zh: 我认为基于应用程序的方法作为一线服务可以非常、非常有用，嗯，

sentences.en: as to kind of help give people a little bit of the skills and a little bit of the support
sentences.zh: 可以帮助人们获得一点技能和一点支持，

sentences.en: to help them self-manage, uh, their way through some of those challenges.
sentences.zh: 帮助他们自我管理，度过其中的一些挑战。

sentences.en: As people get into more serious levels of depression and anxiety, um, the kinds of clinical diagnoses
sentences.zh: 当人们进入更严重的抑郁和焦虑水平时，嗯，也就是我们许多心理学家，

sentences.en: that so many of us psychologists, um, treat, uh, I, I think we have less evidence in that
sentences.zh: 所治疗的各种临床诊断，嗯，我，我认为我们在那个领域证据较少，

sentences.en: space that the, that apps, that the apps can work very well on their own, uh, to help, help people to manage their emotions.
sentences.zh: 即应用程序、那些应用程序能够独立发挥很好作用，嗯，来帮助人们管理他们的情绪。

sentences.en: But I can tell you as a person who thinks about the mental health challenges facing a large
sentences.zh: 但我可以告诉你，作为一个考虑到大学里大量年轻人所面临的心理健康挑战的人，

sentences.en: number of young people in a university, I think apps absolutely have a role to play in helping
sentences.zh: 我认为应用程序绝对可以发挥作用，帮助我们确保能够提供技能培训和支持，

sentences.en: us ensure that we can deliver the kind of skills training and support that would be just too
sentences.zh: 而这些对于我们来说太难做到了，因为坦白讲，我们所有人都缺乏足够的辅导员来很好地完成这项工作。

sentences.en: difficult for us to do because we just, frankly, none of us have enough counselors to be able to do, to do that work well.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几年里，你是否看到你的研究受到的关注有所上升？

sentences.en: Have you seen an uptick in interest over the past couple of years in your research?
sentences.zh: 嗯，特别是，你知道的，我们从COVID-19大流行期间的民意调查中发现，我们很多人都在无意中增重或减重。

sentences.en: Um, particularly because the, you know, we have found from our polling during the COVID-19 pandemic is that a lot of us are gaining or losing weight that we didn't intend to.
sentences.zh: 两者都有。

sentences.en: Both are true.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Goodness.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 呃，人们，这里的人们，呃，这里的人们，呃，经常向我诉说他们，你知道的，他们的疫情体重，或者是，或者，你知道的，他们的封锁，封锁期间的

sentences.en: Uh, people, people, people around here, uh, around here, uh, have often been telling me about their, you know, their pandemic weight or the, or, you know, their lockdown, lockdown
sentences.zh: 体重增加，以及这些，这些事情。

sentences.en: gains and these, these things.
sentences.zh: 而且，我们有一些证据表明，事实确实如此。

sentences.en: And, and we have a little bit of evidence that, that that's true.
sentences.zh: 呃，在疫情期间一直追踪体重的研究明确显示，人们的体重一直在增加。

sentences.en: Uh, the studies that have been tracking weight during the pandemic definitely show that people have been gaining.
sentences.zh: 我们看到人们的体力活动量有所下降，还有其他类型的有问题的不健康行为。

sentences.en: We've seen a retreat in the amount of physical activity that people are getting other types of, of problematic health behaviors.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我们在试验中看到对数字健康方法的极大兴趣，嗯，也有很多人有兴趣报名。

sentences.en: So yeah, we're seeing a lot of interest in, in digital health approaches in our trials, um, and a lot of, a lot of interest in, in signing up.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在疫情期间，我们许多人都变得更加习惯使用技术来管理生活的方方面面。

sentences.en: Um, a lot of us have just gotten more comfortable using technology during the pandemic to manage all manner of, of aspects of our lives.
sentences.zh: 而且，我认为这也是其中之一。

sentences.en: And, and I think this is, this is just another one of them.

sentences.en: Um, I'll tell you the other thing that's happened in that regard, that's been really useful is that the policy environment has changed a great deal during the pandemic.

sentences.en: And so my, my vision for what digital health could represent as part of the healthcare system has changed a lot in the last two years.

sentences.en: I now really think, um, that we, we have the ability to, to very widely implement digital strategies as part of, as part of our health system.

sentences.en: They've like been things that you download, um, from companies that aren't necessarily associated with where you go to get your healthcare.
sentences.zh: 嗯，而且，这种情况正在非常、非常迅速地改变。

sentences.en: Um, and, and that's changing very, very rapidly.
sentences.zh: 而且，而且，呃，你知道的，如果说疫情还有什么一线生机的话，我认为这就是其中之一。

sentences.en: And it's, and it's, uh, you know, if there's a, if there's any silver lining in the pandemic, I think that that's, that's one.

sentences.zh: 是的，你，嗯，那，那是非常，这是一个非常好的观点，

sentences.zh: 金，因为我，我看到两件事正在发生。

sentences.en: Kim, because I, I'm seeing two things happen.
sentences.zh: 一是每当一个大型医疗系统决定做一些新事情时，呃，它们都会面临“自建还是购买”的挑战。

sentences.en: One is whenever a big health system decides it wants to do something new, uh, they have this build versus buy challenge.

sentences.zh: 所以我看到的是医疗系统同时在做这两件事。

sentences.zh: 呃，我们一直被，呃，来自医疗系统的联系所淹没，这些医疗系统有兴趣更多地了解构建自己的，呃，

sentences.en: And we're definitely seeing deals between most major health systems and existing providers to make these types of apps available to their patients.

sentences.zh: 嗯，对于那些没有从商业应用程序提供商那里得到想要答案的医疗系统，

sentences.en: And my hope is that a lot of the big health systems will choose to work with folks who already have things sitting on the shelf that work pretty well.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望高质量应用程序的市场前景在未来几年内能够有所改善。

sentences.en: So I'm hoping that the landscape for high quality apps improves, uh, over the next couple of years.

sentences.zh: 你，你在研究实验室里正在做什么？

sentences.en: is, you know, the, the, what we say around the app, the lab a lot is if you generally speaking, if you use more, you lose more.

sentences.zh: 保持参与。

sentences.zh: 这是一种更简单、更有效的获得护理的方式，而且费用要低得多。
